scope: 17 October read-only native MCP inspection of the exact saved ASTER-6 joint-interface source; no KiCad editor/IPC listener was running. Native reports operate on saved files and do not prove physical performance.

power_audit_dispositions.disposition: Advisory heuristic, not a circuit failure: AP2112 minimum effective output requirement is 1 uF; C2 is 4.7 uF nominal and C7 adds 100 nF. Effective capacitance/load transient performance remain physical selection checks.

These are the short source/fuse segments before the reverse-polarity diode; they feed no IC. C1 provides 10 uF at U1 VIN on the protected rail. Duplicating caps ahead of reverse protection is not required by this architecture.

power_audit_dispositions.finding: No dedicated test points on four supply rails
power_audit_dispositions.disposition: Optional physical-debug recommendation. J1/J2/J3 expose input/logic supply and ground, and intermediate pad lands can be probed. Dedicated production fixtures/test points were not part of the digital interface brief.

circuit_review.evidence: Fuse then correctly oriented SS14 then U1 input and EN; 10 uF input and 4.7 uF output. Shared 150 mA budget explicit. LDO heat calculation corrected separately to include quiescent current; temperature/headroom claims remain conditional.

3 channels with 1 kOhm / 100 pF and correctly oriented upper/lower BAT54H clamps; 1 kOhm / 10 kOhm / 100 nF NC limit filter. External Schmitt inputs and power sequencing are required; no field transient or 5 V immunity claim.
330 Ohm STEP/DIR/ENABLE paths, pull-down disabling ENABLE when disconnected, 10 kOhm pull-up for a 3.3 V open-drain fault. No motor current/power stage implemented.

LTC2850IS8 /RE and DE tied to pulled-low direction input; 100 nF decoupling has 3.562 mm local copper path. Switchable 120 Ohm endpoint termination and optional single-node 330/330 Ohm bias. Manufacturer confirms internal failsafe for open, shorted and terminated-undriven input. No cable EMC/isolation qualification.

Native MCP saved-board pad readback shows 1.0 x 1.6 mm pads at board x=33.5/36.5 mm, giving 2.0 mm inner gap. MF-NSMF025X-2 selected; no manufacturer-specific 3D body or solder-process approval asserted.
